blocks.title: Observer pattern
blocks.text: Observer design pattern logon ke aise group jaisa hai jo ek source se updates mein dilchaspi rakhte hain: jab bhi koi aham baat ho, source khud-ba-khud tamam dilchaspi rakhne walon ko batata hai. Yeh sab ko baar baar updates dekhne ke baghair ham-aahang rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Observer pattern har object ke baar baar source jaanchne se behtar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Baar baar jaanchna mehnat zaya karta aur jaanch ke darmiyan tabdeeli chhoot sakti hai; Observer pattern mein source har update hote hi ek baar tamam observers ko bhej deta hai.

items: Observer: kuch badalne par source tamam dilchaspi rakhne walon ko khud batata hai; baar baar jaanchna nahi.
